main_text.p: stare.2.Cro.17.6.7.8.Col.1.7. cum Col.12{b} Cæteri vero prout a Deo, eiusq; spiritu ducuntur muneri incumbant.{a} Leu.4.15.2.Cro.19.8.11.Psal.74.7.8.Esa. 4.4.62.8.Ier. Luc.5.17.Act.14.23.Tit.1.5.Phil.1.1. Act.20.7.Act.15.1. 1.Pet.5.1.Iac.5.14.Rom.6.12.Act. 6.1.2.Col.1.7.& 4.17.{b}Ion.1.3.& 4.2.& omnibus prophetiæ Esa.Ezech. Act.13.1.4. & 8.25. & 16.9. Vnde spiritu deuicti pergebant.Act.20.22. Vnde spiritus opera etiam sæpius immediate translati sunt. Ezech 40.1.Act.8.38.
Secunda est de vocationis partibus, tum electione. ordinatione.
Electio, est prima vocationis pars, qua qui ad munus ordinarium promouendi sunt : ex iudicio totius ecclesiæ, vel maioris partis, designandi sunt. Leu.8.4.Act.1.& 6.6.& 14.23.1.Cor.8.19.Col.1.1.
Huius autem partes sunt munus Administrantium. Populi.
Administratium munus est, vt tam de donis specialibus, quam de moribus diligentissime exquirete reliquis in sententijs ferendis præeant. Leu.8.3.4.5. Num.8.9.10.Act.14 23.
Populi est, consensu electionem approbare & stabilire.ex præced.ibid. & Act.1.26. Act.6.6.& 14. 23.2.Cor.8.19.Gal.1.1.

Hic autem ratio ordinaria est, administrantes prius probatos, populo fistendi, vt ipsi post tempus idoneum, vel consensum præbeant, vel si obiiciendum quid habeant, obijciant, difficultate expedita acquiescant

page.notes: Marginal notes of the left page are only fragments at the left edge (unreadable, cut off); not transcribed. Catchword: none visible. The printed text at the foot right "(b)ß" is a reference mark, partly obscured. Words "Administratium" and "obijciant" are as printed; "Administrantium" in the side-bracket reads as printed. Doubtful: "exquirete" (printed as "exquiretes"), "Cæteri", and the text beside the brace lines.
